characters.voice_style: Nostalgic male narrator, warm and reflective, slight rasp of experience, speaks with reverence for the old days. Starts heavy and broken in hook, builds warmth during origin, sharpens with pride during empire-building, drops to devastation during scam, rebuilds quiet determination, finishes with earned confidence.

story_arc.hook: I lost everything in Growtopia. My world, my items, my reputation. But that's not how my story ends.
story_arc.origin: Started as a noob with nothing. First day, someone gave me a World Lock. Changed my life forever.
story_arc.turning_point: Built an empire. Thousands of worlds. Then the great scam took it all — Crown, Wings, Locks, years of work, gone.
story_arc.revelation: Came back with nothing but knowledge. Built it all again. Now richer than ever. The real treasure in Growtopia is knowledge.

environments_used: Beginner world with basic blocks and a single small tree
Bustling trade world with vending machines and display boxes
Empty devastated world with broken blocks and cracked ground
Grand rebuilt world with pixel-art castle, fountains, and Diamond Lock display cases

narrator.register: young teen boy (~13), NOT an adult man; light youthful timbre, warm, reflective first-person. Casual_Guy/Young_Knight/Deep_Voice_Man read too adult for a child narrator (burned 2026-07-17).
narrator.note: No approved Chatterbox sample owned by this bible. The default skin is the nameless everyplayer, so voice identity is not critical — MiniMax narration is acceptable per user authorization.
